description: Schema for source-linked organization capability/policy fixtures. It keeps source assertions, fictional stipulations, unknowns, confirmation state, and effective dates distinct.
provenance_rules: Every source_assertion has a source_ref and locator.
Every stipulation is explicitly marked and is not presented as an organizational fact.
Unknown availability, capacity, ownership, cost, and lead time are not inferred from public expertise descriptions.
A policy change records scope and effective_date; it does not silently rewrite prior versions.
